title: Ripple market scan
description: Result of the agent tool market_scan(product, city?). Live results come from Nimble and are extracted by Gemini into this shape; demo mode reads a cached file with the same shape. This is WEB CONTEXT, never a model input — the UI must label it as such and show the sources.

query.description: The search that produced it, echoed back.

source.description: 'nimble' = fetched live. 'cache' = a real earlier Nimble result replayed. 'demo' = illustrative sample data shipped with the repo, NOT a real scan — the UI must say so.

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 time the result was obtained.

price.description: Price per unit in the same currency as the model. null when the page did not state one.

unit.description: What the price is per, e.g. 'per bag, monthly subscription'.

offer.description: Any current promotion stated on the page.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence from the structured-output step.

comparison.description: Pre-computed so the agent never does arithmetic on these numbers itself.

sentence.description: The exact line the UI shows, e.g. 'Your new price $25.92 is above 2 of 3 competitors in Austin.'

note.description: Shown with the card. For demo data this must state that the figures are illustrative.
